 Ajay Mohan Goel, Judge (Oral)

By way of this petition the petitioners have sought the following relief: "issue a Writ of mandamus in favour of the petitioner and against the respondents as the land for development of National Highways and associated purposes was acquired under Section 3 of the National Highway Act, 1956 and the compensation amount be released/awarded in favour of the petitioners as per the award Puran Singh & Others vs Union Of India & Others on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102947342/
1 passed by respondent No.3 copy of which is already on record as Annexure P1."
2.

sentences.text: When the matter was listed on 30.11.2023, the following order was passed: "Notice.

Mr. Balram Sharma, learned Deputy Solicitor General of India, Mr. Sumit Raj Sharma, learned Whether reporters of the local papers may be allowed to see the judgment?
.
Counsel and Mr. Pushpender Jaswal, learned Additional Advocate General, accept notice on behalf of respondent No. 1, respondents No. 2 and 4 and respondent No. 3, respectively.

Learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that the grievance of the petitioners is that despite an award of having been passed pursuant to acquisition of their land by respondents No. 1, 2 and 4, the award amount has not been paid to them."
rt 3.
Today, learned counsel for respondents No.1, 2 and 4 submits that as far as admitted amount petitioners are entitled is concerned, same already stands released in favour of the petitioners, but
with regard to the amount which according to respondents the petitioners are not entitled to,
arbitration proceedings stand initiated against the award of Competent Authority for Land Acquisition (CALA) in accordance with the provisions of National Highways Act, 1956.

4. In view of the above submissions, learned counsel for respondents No.1, 2 and 2 as agreed, these proceedings are ordered to be closed, with the observation that the arbitration proceedings be taken to their logical conclusion, as expeditiously as possible.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, stand disposed of.

(Ajay Mohan Goel) Judge December 18, 2023 (Rishi)
